description: Implementation of the TrustStoreInMemory class managing in-memory trust certificates, including adding, clearing, and retrieving trust information for certificates.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemory
classes.description: In-memory trust store managing certificates and their trust levels.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemory::Entry
classes.description: Represents an individual certificate entry with associated trust information.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trust store is empty.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the trust store.

methods.name: AddTrustAnchorWithExpiration
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with enforced expiration.

methods.name: AddTrustAnchorWithConstraints
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with enforced constraints.

methods.name: AddDistrustedCertificateForTest
methods.description: Adds a distrusted certificate for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddCertificateWithUnspecifiedTrust
methods.description: Adds a certificate with unspecified trust.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates matching a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a certificate exists in the trust store.

methods.name: AddCertificate
methods.description: Internal method to add a certificate with trust info.

methods.name: GetEntry
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve an entry for a certificate.
